en: D-Damn... You'll... live to regret this...all of you...
Do you fools realise what you're doing?! If I die, so do the women we took!
Nanna! Mareeta! Where are you!? Please, answer me!
Little Nan, Mareeta... Raydrik must've taken'em.
What!? That means... they were taken to Manster, right?
Yeah -as bargaining chips, in case Weissman couldn't finish the job. It's sort of thing Raydrik would pull, all right.
It's sort of thing Raydrik would pull, all right.
God's breath... Commander, we have to give chase!
The two of them are counting on us!
Now look here, little Leif-
Commander, you yourself said it: I'm not a child anymore.
Nanna and Mareeta were taken captive because of me -and I refuse to let anyone suffer in my place.
I will never again let someone sacrifice their life in exchange for mine.
...I understand. We leave at dawn, then.
I won't lie little Lord: this is gonna get rough.
Get some rest while you can.
Tanya? What are you doing here?
What does it look like, Osian?
I'm here to help you guys, any way I can!
"Help any way you can", huh?
In that case, turn tail and march back home.
That's the only way a kid like you could help -you'd just get in the way.
You've got some nerve, Osian!
You're just a kid yourself, you know!?
You want me gone, I'm gone -not all of us are as eager to throw ourselves into danger as you!
Barely escaping the burning of Castle Lenster with his life,
young Prince Leif was looked after by Finn, his last knight and retainer.
Together with Finn's daughter, Nanna, the trio fled pursuers sent by the conquerors of North Thracia: the Grannvale Empire, which lay to the west.
Yet Finn proved stronger than those who hunted them, and the three made their way to the cities
of Alster
and Tahra, posing as common vagrants.
Eventually, they drifted into Fiana, a small village on Thracia's eastern coast.
Fiana was an independent community with its own militia, the Fiana Freeblades,
lead by the swordswoman Eyvel, who welcomed Leaf's group as if they were her own kin.
Under her watchful eye, the deposed prince spent his childhood in Fiana, growing into maturity alongside youths of common birth.
But now, in the year 776 of the Grannvale Calendar...
Those Imperial dogs took Dame Mareeta and Lady Nanna -just snatched'em right up like was cattle!
You're not gonna let'em get away with that, are you?
If you're fixin' to fight the Empire, take this with you.
This here ring's enchanted with some spell or another.
But don't just wear it on your finger like some common bauble!
You gotta actually USE it for it to do any good!
Y'all made it back! What a relief...
But look, there's no Fiana Freeblades without Fiana, right?
So don't just stop with them pirates -drive the Empire from our village, too!
Not to imply that I ain't grateful, a' course.
Take this with you. Use it if you get scraped up.
We don't have much in the way of medicine, but it's the least we can do after everythin' the Commander's done fer us.
Weapons can be mighty expensive, can't they?
Most folk here gotta make do by nicking supplies from Imperial troops.
It's awful risky, but if you can capture an enemy alive, you get to help yourself to their stuff.
Matter of fact, I got the drop of an Imperial soldier myself.
Heard'im snoring from three houses away, so I took me a souvenir!
...Not that it'll do me much good, though.
Probably better off in your hands, I reckon.
And hey, if you don't need it, you can just hawk it for somethin' you do need.
You pullin' your weight in the Freeblades, boy?
Last thing the Commander Eyvel needs is to babysit you.
We're risking life and limb to protect the village, and you're giving me a lecture?
You've got a strange sense of gratitude, old man.
Not even the Empire knockin' down our front door can stop that fool mouth of yours, I see.
Well, no point in draggin' this out. Here. This is what you came for, right?
For once you read my mind.
When a fight breaks out, I just feel off without this axe at my side.
Which don't explain why you forget it at home half the damn time!
Hey, I came her efor the axe, not to get chewed out!
If that's all you wanted, then get going!
Go on, now! Don't keep the Commander waitin' on you!
You don't need to tell me twice!
Where has that fool boy of mine gone off to in this fracas?.
I swear, my Osian's gonna get himself killed one of these days...
Those Verdane thugs are lucky Lord Byron isn't arounf with his holy sword, Tyrfing.
They wouldn't stand a chance!
Big Brother! I've got something special for you!
You can use this to keep yourself safe, right?
An... axe? Where in the world did you get such a fine weapon?
Darnedest thing... I was walkin' past the lake up on the mountain, when this strange ol' crone just floated outta the water!
She gave it to me, then vanished, quick as you can blink!
I been keepin' it for you, an' takin' real good care of it.
Now go put it to use, an' make me proud!
Hey, hey, have you seen my big brother Halvan?
He's got me awful scared...
I hope he's all right...
Dagdar!? You... came to fight with us?
Eyvel! Does me heart good to see you in one piece!
Listen, ya have any idea why the Empire would come all the way out here?
It have anything to do with... the boy?
Yeah. The little Lord Leif, he's... he's not just some nobleman.
He's the heir of House Lenster.
I've been helping him hide from the Empire.
I'm sorry... I shouldn't have kept it from you.
Mm, I figured as much. Well, no use worryin' about it now.
Long as I get to cut down some of those Imperial dastards meself, we're even.
Papa, the fighting started already!
Ain't no good way to go about this damned battle...
Don't matter how good Eyvel is, there is only one of her an' over a dozen of them. We need to hurry.
Oh, fer cryin' out loud! Not again...
